question: Can all ritual aims be accomplished by a mere oblation of sesame and ghee?
premises: An oblation can be performed using only sesame and ghee.
Such an oblation is described as sufficient in its mere performance.
Ritual aims are encompassed by all actions to be accomplished.
inference: Therefore, one can accomplish all actions through the mere performance of a sesame-and-ghee oblation.
uncertainties: The scope of sarvakarmāṇi may be contextually limited to the rites discussed in this section.
plain_english: By merely performing an oblation of sesame and ghee, one can accomplish all actions.
